basic_info.description: This bright and modern one-bedroom, one-bath condo offers both convenience and sophistication, in a prime location. The bright open floor plan flows easily from the living area to kitchen, and dining. Located at the rear of the building, it overlooks the tranquil common garden, offering privacy and quiet. The private terrace allows for seamless indoor-outdoor living and the gas fireplace adds an element of warmth on cool evenings. Equipped with professional grade stainless steel Viking appliances, the efficient open kitchen will inspire culinary adventures. The recently renovated bath has heated floors, dual sinks and a large walk-in shower with multiple shower heads. In-unit laundry, custom window coverings, stylish wallpaper, and deeded storage complete this well located home. Conveniently located just minutes from Whole Foods, restaurants, shops and transit.
